heading: Easy Origami Heart
introduction: This origami heart is one of the quickest folds on the site, perfect for cards, bookmarks, or a quick handmade gift. All you need is one square sheet of paper, ideally colored on one side.
durationNote: Planning estimate; allow extra time for your first attempt.
paper: One square sheet of thin origami paper, about 15 × 15 cm (6 × 6 in).

steps.title: Fold in Half
steps.text: With the colored side down, fold your square in half vertically, then unfold to leave a center crease.

steps.title: Fold the Top Corners Down
steps.text: Fold the top two corners down to the center crease, forming a triangle shape at the top.

steps.title: Fold the Bottom Point Up
steps.text: Fold the bottom point up to meet the base of the triangle, creating a pentagon-like shape.

steps.title: Round the Top Lobes
steps.text: Fold the top two corners inward and slightly downward to round them into the heart's two lobes.

steps.title: Tuck and Flip
steps.text: Tuck the bottom point behind the lobes slightly to sharpen the heart's shape, then flip the paper over.

steps.title: Your Heart is Complete!
steps.text: Flatten all the creases firmly. Your origami heart is ready to use as a card topper, bookmark, or gift tag.

tips: Line up corners before pressing a crease from the middle outwards.
Keep the paper facing the same way as the instruction before each fold.
commonMistakes: If layers do not line up, return to the last clear step rather than forcing the next fold.
Thick paper becomes difficult to fold as layers build up; try a larger, thinner square.
